source.dataset: Supplied Mississauga UNHEARD challenge pack; 2021 census aggregates
source.attribution: City of Mississauga; supplied corrected derived census and coverage tables
source.license: Pack declares City open-data terms; dataset-specific redistribution terms unresolved; local use only pending T-019
source.scope: Sum of supplied tracked categories; not city population, unique-person inference or geographic ASR performance
source.ranking_policy: Missing supplied task audio only; city_home_speakers descending, language_id ascending for ties
source.ward_selection_policy: Top 3 by count; independently top 3 by count/population_language_base; ward_id ascending for ties; null-base shares excluded
source.ward_export_policy: suggested_ward_ids follows count ranking; suggested_action labels both independent rankings and values
source.task_dataset_attribution: MInDS-14: PolyAI / Gerz et al. (2021); Speech-MASSIVE: FBK; supplied coverage counts only
source.task_dataset_licenses: MInDS-14 CC BY 4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/PolyAI/minds14; Speech-MASSIVE CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, https://mt.fbk.eu/speech-massive/; no audio/transcripts exported
source.experiment_status: not_tested; this pipeline performs no experiments and emits no CER/WER metrics

items.reason: No labelled spoken-request audio in the supplied MInDS-14 and Speech-MASSIVE subsets
items.suggested_action: Plan consented, realistic municipal-request evaluation in Urdu. Top wards by home-speaker count (recruitment volume): Ward 10: 4,520; Ward 6: 3,590; Ward 11: 2,560. Independently, top wards by home-language share of population_language_base (concentration): Ward 10: 6.12%; Ward 6: 4.75%; Ward 11: 4.29%. Suggested ward IDs follow the count ranking. Work with community partners to recruit willing participants; evaluate outcomes before claiming improvement.
limitations: Missing audio refers only to supplied task-dataset subsets, not all recordings worldwide or provider support.
2021 home-language categories do not establish English ability, service demand or individual need.
Ward counts and shares guide future recruitment; no ward-specific recognition rates were measured.
FLEURS speakers are not identified Mississauga residents; pilot outcomes must remain separate.
Top three wards are descriptive, with ascending ward ID breaking ties; shares with unavailable bases are excluded.
Share text is rounded to two decimals for display; ranking uses unrounded count/base ratios.
